name: Big, No, MASSIVE Iron Axes

angles.text: A blacksmith who can forge massive iron axes will find a ready buyer among the bloodthirsty Magram.

faq.answer: Grolkar, a centaur living in Magram Village, demands the weapons to arm his clan.
The Magram fight a bitter clan war against the Gelkis centaur and need heavy weapons to crush them.
faq.q: Why does Grolkar want these weapons?

faq.answer: Grolkar stays at Magram Village in eastern Desolace.
Grolkar demands two massive iron axes to test what outside smiths can produce.
You must remain on good terms with the Magram clan, which means staying hostile to their Gelkis enemies.
faq.q: Do the Magram trust just anyone?

sections.body: In the dry wastes of Desolace, the Magram centaur wage a brutal feud against their Gelkis cousins. Grolkar demands heavy iron weapons to crush his clan's rivals and tests whether an outsider has the skill to forge them. You must keep the favor of the Magram and bring two massive iron axes to their village.
sections.title: Arms for the Clan

summary: Grolkar of the Magram centaur wants heavy weapons to smash the rival Gelkis clan in Desolace. He demands that you bring two massive iron axes to Magram Village to prove your craftsmanship and aid their war.
attribution: In-game quest text: Big, No, MASSIVE Iron Axes
